text:
mina: FYI i've been digging into the duplicate billing noise. reproducer shows claim and finalize both surviving retries when the finalizer ack is lost.

ryan: can you paste the minimal trace? i want to see where the dedupe key fails.

mina: sure: `claim(id=cid123) -> kafka ack lost -> claim replay -> finalize(id=cid123, final_hash=abc) -> finalize retried` 

olga: that's the classic race. claim_id alone isn't enough because some clients reissue claim ids on retry.

mina: proposal: replace claim-facing fanout with a sidecar-local claim only. emit one `billing_event.v1` that contains `proof_bundle` (three short fingerprints) + `dedupe_key`. Proof bundle = [req_digest, prefix_digest, final_digest] truncated.

product-analytics: dashboards depend on an "inflight" signal. if claim isn't emitted, how do we surface pending usage?

mina: sidecars will expose an internal metrics endpoint `/internal/metering/inflight` with per-tenant counts. prometheus scrapes it; dashboards switch to that during mirror.

ryan: what about consumers that don't have access to internal metrics (third-party kafka consumers)?

mina: during mirror mode we'll emit both claim and v1 billing_event with header `x-metering-mirror:true`. consumers can opt into v1. after 28 days we flip.

olga: add `replay_source` field (live|backfill) and `original_ts` optionally. backfills set replay_source=backfill so ledger treats them idempotently.

mina: dedupe_key = hex(trunc_sha256(req_id || final_digest)) suggested. ledger uses dedupe_key+replay_source to decide upsert.

patchbot: branch "metering/proof-bundle-rollout" created. CI passed.

ryan: tests? we need an automated sim that pushes the sequence of transient acks and retries.

mina: wrote `tools/sim_metering.py --scenario retry-ack-loss --seed 2026 --iterations 5000`. it catches duplicate ledger writes currently. i'll add asserts after change.

olga: migration: per-tenant feature flag so we can flip off v1 for risky customers. Also a kafka header `x-metering-version: v1` to help consumers.

product-analytics: we'll need a migration plan for OLAP joins. i'll prepare a script to remap claim->billing_event joins and validate counts during mirror.

ryan: storage impact? approx +32 bytes/event for proof_bundle+dedeupe metadata. at 150M events/month ~4.8GB. acceptable.

mina: failure mode: if sidecar crashes before final write we may lose inflight visibility but not double-charge. we should set claim TTL 48h and periodic compaction job.

olga: also update replay tooling: prefer proof_bundle to reconstruct state; fall back to claim payload if missing. add a compatibility mode for older consumers.

mina: i'll draft an RFC follow-up with schema examples, sim logs, mirror timeline, per-tenant rollout, and rollback steps. pinging @ryan @olga for reviewers.

ryan: LGTM. schedule staging mirror canary after tests.

product-analytics: will watch metrics and create alert if duplicate_charge_rate > 0.005% during the mirror window.

mina: thanks all. i'll post the RFC link when ready.
